value.rationale: The deliberately constructed compact quasinilpotent shift exhibits a mathematically interpretable, sharply quantified spectral phenomenon: exactly two simple eigenvalues per small geometric annulus, a logarithmic Weyl count and an alternating superexponentially small drift invisible to coarse spectral existence theorems. This fills a structural quantitative gap beyond generic rank-one perturbation criteria. Limited to explicitly engineered q-product coefficients and fixed nonzero coupling.

limitations: Constants depend on fixed q in (0,1) and alpha!=0, no uniformity as q->1 or alpha->0; no finite-index spectrum classification. Entire-function earlier asymptotic equivalence remains bibliographically possible.
